items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: In fact I took piano lessons from Marl Morrow.

ctx.x: Was Marl Morrow playing then too?
Uh-huh. In fact I took piano lessons from Marl Morrow.
Oh. Well, Marl Morrow had, what started earlier than you? Are you and Marl Morrow the same age?
